critic_value.sentence: Small sample: the Critic denied 9 and approved 12, too few to say whether it was right (20 of each are needed).

headline.sentence: Small sample: 18 closed so far, 20 needed. On average the recommendations were -0.4 points against SPY; 58 recommendations are too few to call it.

caveats.sentence: Returns are price returns with no dividends, for the stocks and for the benchmark alike.
Every purchase fills at the next regular open of the stored daily bars, with no slippage and no commission.
Exits are judged on daily bars: a day that touches both the stop and the target counts as the stop, and on the day of the entry only the stop can fire.
There are fewer outcomes than the minimum sample, so every rate and average is a first look, not a verdict.
A position that no rule has closed is open: it is marked at the last stored close and is never counted as a win.
A position that crossed a stock split was adjusted on the split's date from the stored split table.
